FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 483
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/07/2025
House Bill 483 as introduced would exempt virtual currency from ad valorem taxation. Virtual
currency is not currently subject to ad valorem tax, and due to this, this bill would not directly
affect state or local funding.
